review_scope: Exact clause, not the narrower historical witness label. A statutory condition is not established by a requested controller or scene flag.

common_activation.text: pathway or lane provided for bicycles, electric bicycles or electric scooters
common_activation.cpu_plan: Keep authored facility geometry and Native road/lane readback as separate evidence. An independent designation packet must identify that the sampled polygon is a provided bicycle pathway or lane. The current authored bounds do not establish statutory designation.

branches.controlled_variable: full body crossing into provided facility with entrance context fixed
branches.cpu_plan: Saved boundary-crossing measurement using original 20 Hz body vertices, Native lane identity, and time-scoped exception packet; compare entry absent versus present on the same alley cell.

Existing probe_a/probe_b saved diagnostics measure 0.0 versus 9.36 square meters in synthetic 480-frame histories. Add designation, time-scoped exception proof, strict compatibility and independent delivery audit before selection.

branches.controlled_variable: parked full-body facility overlap with parking act established separately from a transient stop
branches.cpu_plan: A distinct saved act packet must establish parking behavior and duration; speed zero alone cannot distinguish parking from stopping or standing.

branches.controlled_variable: moving body occupancy of the provided facility
branches.cpu_plan: Measure moving original Native body overlap across a bounded interval with the same facility designation and exception checks.

branches.exact_text: shall yield the right-of-way to any person riding a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter ... on the pathway or lane
branches.controlled_variable: qualifying rider path and observed ego response at a shared conflict region
branches.cpu_plan: Separate same-cell controlled interactions for bicycle, electric bicycle and electric scooter identities; saved original trajectories and controls must measure arrival, conflict and response without inferring a legal verdict from a model metric.

branches.exact_text: or a pedestrian as provided in subsection 6 of NRS 484B.297 on the pathway or lane
branches.controlled_variable: NRS 484B.297(6) qualifying pedestrian entry and observed ego response
branches.cpu_plan: Source-bound sidewalk obstruction, impassable area between sidewalk and bicycle lane, due-care path, and return-as-soon-as-practicable evidence must accompany a crossing/yield interaction. Current stationary synthetic pedestrian does not qualify.

branches.exact_text: When entering or exiting an alley or driveway
branches.controlled_variable: time-bounded facility crossing during actual alley or driveway entry/exit
branches.cpu_plan: Compare crossing and stationary occupancy with the same entrance geometry; original body trajectory and entrance bounds must show entry/exit timing.

branches.exact_text: When operating or parking a disabled vehicle
branches.controlled_variable: observed disabled-vehicle state during facility occupancy
branches.cpu_plan: Require a source packet for actual disabled state and its interval; a hazard signal or a requested flag alone is insufficient.

branches.exact_text: To avoid conflict with other traffic
branches.controlled_variable: observed conflicting traffic and avoidance path into facility
branches.cpu_plan: Retain original counterpart trajectory and control history; compare a genuine conflict setup with a matched nonconflict setup.

branches.exact_text: In the performance of official duties
branches.controlled_variable: documented official-duty context, body occupancy and timing
branches.cpu_plan: An authoritative duty packet is needed; vehicle paint, lights or an engineering request do not establish purpose. Same-cell physical representability remains to be reviewed.

branches.exact_text: In compliance with the directions of a police officer
branches.controlled_variable: source-visible officer direction and matching driver action
branches.cpu_plan: Bind officer identity, actual direction, timing and driver response. A controller command without the officer event cannot establish compliance.
Require an emergency event packet with independent provenance and temporal relation to the occupancy. Requested scene flags are not observations.

compatibility_blocker.cause: Pinned worker-fixture-recipe-v1 retains the runtime capture base except case.json, config.json and result.json; it rejects additions that shadow existing source files. The sole pinned base has three frames, while exact C10052 attempts and saved finalization require 480 frames.
compatibility_blocker.effect: No strict v2 positive/negative compatibility receipt can be claimed for either current exact case using the frozen recipe. Existing v1 probes remain diagnostics.
compatibility_blocker.owned_follow_up: Continue independent branch construction and audits while the shared frozen limitation is recorded by the lead. Do not relabel v1 receipts as v2.
